author: GamingBolt
description:
In the fourth part of our recap of the entire Gears of War franchise, we covered the events of Gears of War 2. Here in part 5, we are going to move on to events of Gears of War 3 and Gears Judgment Aftermath.

What do you do after effectively ruining the world? And I don't mean figuratively shattering it into an infinite number of pieces. I mean rendering it inhospitable for everyone, all to destroy your enemy.

It's not really your fault. War was at your doorstep, and the enemy would have done it first. Then there's the enemy of your enemy, who's far from a friend, and who knows what they're thinking? By all accounts, the only choice left is the most obvious, even if it means destroying the last stronghold of humankind. One more weight on the COG's guilty conscience, another tragedy for Sera to remember as it inches ever closer to annihilation.

author: GamingBolt
description:
Out now on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, Remedy Entertainment's action RPG seems to have been received well by players, at least based on Steam. It's the studio's biggest launch on the platform ever, with nearly 35,000 peak concurrent players and an 89 percent “Very Positive” rating from 1,411 user reviews. 

There's praise for various elements including the combat.
title: Control Resonant's Combat Is Deceptive, and That's What Makes It So Satisfying

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered can be easy to write off as a fresh coat of paint on a title that’s now too old to be considered relevant. But that would be ignoring a long list of changes that could make it become something else entirely, as it paves the way for the franchise’s future. 

But can it compete against a strong lineup of close titles and manage to be the one its players come back to before they eventually hop onto GTA 6?

We believe it does have the potential to achieve that, and we're certainly happy to talk about it. Join us as we take you through why we think old could be gold in this instance of a beloved classic going up against some new heavyweights.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Could Be The Game To Beat Before GTA 6
